desc.zh: 来自奥苏安的迷雾法师，独自漂泊远东的高等精灵航海士。
desc.en: A Mist Mage from Ulthuan, a High Elf navigator wandering alone across the Far East.

story.zh: 瑟兰娜曾在海领主艾斯林麾下的海上巡逻队担任迷雾法师。她不仅擅长使用迷雾法术，对其他法术与航海术也熟稔于心。她独自沿着远东航路辗转至今，少有人知她为何滞留于此。
story.en: Serena once served as a Mist Mage in the sea patrols of Sea Lord Aislinn. She is not only skilled in mist magic, but well versed in other lores and the art of navigation besides. She has drifted along the sea lanes of the Far East ever since, and few know why she lingers here.
